from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,shutil,tempfile,zipfile
source=Path('scripts/prepare_cua_hermes_candidate.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('augment',source)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
root=Path(r'C:\Users\adyba\docker-chatgpt-devbox\workspace\cua-termux-native-evidence-20261017\39056267366')
api=json.loads((root/'artifact-api.json').read_text())
archive=root/'artifact-reconstructed.zip'
actual=module.sha256(archive)
assert api['digest']=='sha256:'+actual and api['size_in_bytes']==archive.stat().st_size
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
 entries=[x for x in z.infolist() if x.filename.endswith('bin/cua-driver')]
 assert len(entries)==1
 info=entries[0]
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cua-elf-read-',dir=root.parent) as temp:
  target=Path(temp)/'cua-driver'
  with z.open(info) as src,target.open('wb') as dst: shutil.copyfileobj(src,dst)
  print(json.dumps({'augmenter_sha256':module.sha256(source),'artifact_id':api['id'],'archive_sha256':actual,'member':info.filename,'member_crc32':hex(info.CRC),'bytes':target.stat().st_size,'driver_sha256':module.sha256(target),'actual_elf':module.elf_linkage(target)},indent=2))
